profile.headline: Software Engineer at GoFundMe
profile.summary: Conscientious, resourceful, and team-oriented Software Engineer passionate about delivering high quality products while working in a fast-paced environment.  Dedicated to learning new skills and technologies in order to improve processes along the way.

positions.title: Software Engineer ll
positions.description: Skills: JavaScript · Cypress · TypeScript · React.js · Authentication · PHP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: JavaScript · Cypress · TypeScript · React.js · PHP

positions.title: Atlassian App QA Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented SmartBear's TM4J Test Management Tool and built out the full regression suite for SmartDraw's reporting solution, VisualScript.
• Meticulously tested and released over 30 Scaled Agile, Project Management, ITSM, and DevOps Reports to Atlassian's Jira and Confluence Cloud and Server Marketplaces.
• Work closely with project managers, senior software engineers, and enterprise account executives to ensure our reports help our clients accurately report their data in SAFe®, ITSM, and DevOps environments.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Dedicated 500+ hours to Thinkful's Nights & Weekends Engineering Program. 
• Learned industry best practices and practical software development standards with a focus on HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, React, Jest, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
• Created and deployed mobile-first applications while learning new languages and frameworks 
• Pair programmed with a senior web developer and classmates to absorb new concepts
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · Node.js · Postman API · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Mobilize QA Lead | Software QA Analyst II
positions.description:
• Lead QA native app projects by creating detailed test plans and cases, while facilitating functional, feature, API, data validation, regression, and end to end testing of the GoFundMe iOS and Android apps. 

• Actively participate in design reviews, sprint kick offs, story point estimations, retros, and backlog grooming meetings in a SCRUM/Agile environment. Collaborate directly with product managers, designers, native app developers, software engineers, QA team, and Customer Happiness Team to assure quality on a multitude of released native app products.

• Work closely with automation engineers to restructure our native app p0 and p1 regression suites as well as our CI/CD processes.

• Helped launch several product changes that expanded our user base and empowered them to easily discover causes they truly care about. Some of these projects include:
 
- Notification service that allows us to introduce action-oriented notifications
- Campaign discovery feature that enables users to support campaigns any where in the world
- Important Causes feature that showcases campaigns related to causes a user cares about
- New donor experience that allows users to make donations through the app
- Team fundraising feature that allows organizers to collectively raise money 
- Improved Post Update feature that enables users to post dynamic video, photo, and text updates 
- Expanded sharing options to encourage organizers to share their campaign on social media platforms their community uses

positions.title: Success Specialist
positions.description:
• Founding member of GoFundMe's first Customer Success team. Help launch products, including ZenDesk LiveChat and  Fundraising Success Tips, focused on improving the success rate of campaign organizers. 

• Worked with development team to implement the first iteration of live chat on the site to coach users in creating high quality campaigns. 

• Gained foundational experience in debugging, working with test environments, and coordinating projects with our product and development teams.

positions.title: Customer Happiness Agent ll
positions.description:
• Provide GoFundMe users with accurate and empathetic support via email in 5 minutes or less. Maintain 90/90/75 metrics: 90% customer satisfaction, 90% internal ratings, and 75 emails per day. Including escalated and VIP situations. 

• Collaborate with Product team on user-feedback and share ideas to improve the product and internal processes. Help form foundational processes for the budding Trust, Community Management, and Customer Success teams. 

• Mentor incoming agents through month long training session, shadowing, and qualitative rating of tickets/emails. Train agents on the product, payment processors, policies, and work culture.

positions.title: Squarespace Web Designer
positions.description:
• Work closely with clients to design and manage professional websites for small businesses. Passionate about creating modern, user-friendly websites that best suit the needs of my clients. 
• Became a Top-Rated Seller on Fiverr.com with over 200 sales and a 4.8 star average in regards to Quality of Service and Seller Level of Communication
• Provided services to set up domains, e-commerce, social media, email marketing.

organizations.name: A Bridge For Kids
organizations.description: Participate in a mentorship program that supports underprivileged high school students in achieving their dreams in academics, athletics, or the arts. Each student is provided financial support, academic resources, and mentorship throughout their high school journey.
